description: This Kotlin source file defines the singleton object 'ShopRepository', which serves as a data repository for an online shopping platform. It provides mock product and category data, manages a shopping cart, tracks recent searches, and handles local persistence. The class exposes methods for retrieving data, modifying cart contents, recording searches, and initializing state from local storage.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: Data class representing a cart item, including the product and quantity, with methods to calculate line total in cents and formatted string.

classes.name: ShopRepository.Product
classes.description: Referenced as part of product list; assumed to be a data class with fields such as id, name, categoryId, priceCents, and description.

classes.name: ShopRepository.Category
classes.description: Referenced as part of category list; assumed to be a data class with fields such as id and name.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Referenced as a class responsible for reading and writing cart and recent searches from local storage; details not provided in current file.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of product categories.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of all products.

methods.name: findProductById
methods.description: Finds a product by its ID.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Gets the name of a category given its ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository, restoring cart and recent searches from local storage.

methods.name: cartLiveData
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object representing the current state of the cart.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of a product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: cartItems
methods.description: Returns a list of CartItem objects representing current cart contents.

methods.name: cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates the total price of the cart in cents.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Returns the list of recent search queries.

methods.name: recordSearchQuery
methods.description: Records a new search query, maintaining recency order and maximum size.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears the list of recent searches.
